text:
sarah: we had a 401 storm during rolling replace when routing hosted->dedicated. we need a tight delegation model. who owns keys? when do we rebind tokens?

maria: short: hosted MUST NOT hold customer long-term plaintext for Private. Dedicated can be managed opt-in. crossing trust boundary = ephemeral assertions.

ben: observed ops problem: runtime grabs token, node replaced, token revoked mid-request -> 401. options: accept overlap (old+new) or lease checkout. overlap is messy; lease seems safer.

olivia: proposal: signed capability handles + local lease. flow: hosted mints short assertion JWT -> dedicated CP verifies -> CP issues signed handle scoped to node/sidecar -> runtime presents handle to sidecar -> sidecar verifies signature & enforces lease before decrypting.

sarah: happy path + fallbacks please + air-gapped variant?

olivia: happy path (brief): 1) client->hosted authn, 2) hosted issues platform assertion JWT (exp ~20s), 3) dedicated CP verifies and issues signed handle (exp ~30s) for node, 4) runtime->sidecar presents handle, sidecar verifies and decrypts locally. fallback: if exchange fails, return 503 or route to cached model variant; air-gapped: either periodic signed bundles or in-cluster signer (prefer customer-managed signer for high throughput).

ben: handle payload sketch: {handle_id,node,scope,issued,exp,sig}. CP signs with local key; publish public key via bootstrap.

maria: rotation: publish previous public keys for >= max handle TTL; rotation staged. need metrics: handle.issue_ms, handle.verify_ms, lease.acquire_ms, rebind_race_errors.

ben: ops action: prototype sidecar implementing handle validation + lease handshake; measure RTTs for hosted->dedicated and hosted->private-airgap. olivia take spike?

olivia: yes, 48h spike. implement issuer, sidecar verifier, perf harness with rolling replace every 30s. will report p50/p95 and failure modes.

sarah: ACTIONS: RFC owner sarah will draft "Delegation Handles & Lease Protocol" RFC; olivia spike (ETA 48h); ben ops-runbook for rebind recovery. ops-bot: scheduled cert rotation 2026-03-24 02:00-03:00 UTC — avoid rollout then.

maria: add trace tag delegation.path and alerts on rebind_race_errors.

ops-bot: alert policy note: create alert if rebind_race_errors > 5 in 5m during deploy windows.

sarah: thanks team. please react :thumbsup: if ok or :eyes: for questions.
